_comment: SynthLink logging. Edit and restart. No environment variables — this file is
the whole configuration.
dir              where the daily logs are written. Relative paths are from
the repo root; an absolute path (e.g. /var/log/synthlink)
works too.
level            console verbosity: error | warn | info. Files always get
everything; this only filters what is echoed live.
debug            per-chunk transfer logging (a line per buffer, both
directions). Extremely verbose — for chasing a stall, not
for normal running.
retentionDays    daily files older than this are deleted. 0 = keep forever.
console          aggregate | off. 'aggregate' echoes all three log streams
live to stdout.
trustProxy       honour CF-Connecting-IP / X-Forwarded-For. Turn OFF if the
server is reachable directly, or clients can forge the IP
that lands in the access log.
trustedProxies   [] = trust any peer (correct when only the proxy can reach
this box). List edge addresses to restrict it.
trackBytes       per-session byte totals for telnet payload and modem audio.
Four integer adds per buffer; the cost is not measurable.
connectTimeoutMs give up on an outgoing telnet connect after this long, so a
black-holed board lands in telnetFailLog instead of hanging
until the OS gives up. 0 = disabled.
